en.headline: Fire at Tin Shui Wai Kingswood Villas flat forces 220 to evacuate
en.dek: A low-floor unit at Le Hu Ju in Kingswood Villas caught fire on Tuesday evening; firefighters put out the blaze with no injuries reported.
body: Police received multiple reports at about 9.57pm on Tuesday that a low-floor flat in Block 7 of Le Hu Ju, Kingswood Villas, Tin Shui Wai, was on fire. Firefighters arrived promptly and extinguished the blaze in about 24 minutes.
About 220 residents were evacuated to safety. Several residents, including a family of three, initially reported being trapped but were assisted out without injury. Some residents left carrying pets.

Initial information indicated a charger had caught fire and ignited a sofa or clutter inside the unit. The Fire Services Department is investigating the exact cause. No one was injured in the incident.

zh.headline: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居單位起火 220居民疏散
zh.dek: 星期二晚天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居7座低層單位起火，消防約24分鐘救熄，約220名居民疏散，無人受傷。
body: 警方於星期二晚上約9時57分接獲多宗報案，指天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居7座一個低層單位起火。消防到場後約24分鐘將火救熄。
約220名居民疏散至安全地方。事發初期有住戶包括一家三口報稱被困，其後獲協助離開，無人受傷。部分居民帶同寵物逃生。
初步資料顯示單位內充電器起火並燃點梳化或雜物。消防處正調查起火原因。事件中無人受傷。
